column1: # Test run schedule for run_all_tests.sh and run_all_tests.ps1.
# class   exclusive  runs alone, before the others, on an otherwise idle
#                    machine: the test keeps several cores busy (renders
#                    larger than one 32-px tile, all-core thread pools,
#                    child-process renders) or a check depends on elapsed
#         single     shares the cores with its render threads forced to one
#                    repo's global.options): its renders spread over a few
#                    cores without gaining much throughput, and nothing it
#                    checks depends on the thread count.
#         pool       shares the cores as it is (the default for any test not
# seconds last measured run time on its own (10-core Apple M-series, before
#         the 2026-11-17 trims; rows for tests added by the 2026-11-18
#         fire-solver merge measured that day); only used to start long
#         Pool tests under 5 s are not listed.
# reason  why the test is exclusive or single.  "N cores" is the measured
#         mean over the test (or its first 60 s), with the peak 3-s window;
#         "on one thread" times were measured with other tests running.

# busy; move such a test here.  A new test that renders more than one tile
